edges.reason: Constructor assigns contractOwner = msg.sender.

Modifier compares msg.sender against contractOwner.
onlyContractOwner gates execution of destroy().

onlyContractOwner gates execution of withdrawnTokens().
onlyContractOwner gates execution of authorize().
onlyContractOwner gates execution of reject().
msg.sender must equal contractOwner for destroy() to run.
destroy() executes the suicide operation.
Selfdestruct beneficiary is the caller msg.sender.
_to is the input argument of changeContractOwnership().
changeContractOwnership writes pendingContractOwner.
_to parameter is stored into pendingContractOwner.
claimContractOwnership authorizes the call using msg.sender.
msg.sender is compared with pendingContractOwner before claiming.
pendingContractOwner is promoted to contractOwner on claim.
claimContractOwnership writes the contractOwner state variable.
claimContractOwnership deletes pendingContractOwner.

Token contract address is used as the transfer callee.
